summary.business_type: B2C SaaS Web Application — AI image metadata removal tool
top_findings: /verify returns 404 to crawlers but is listed in sitemap.xml and linked sitewide
No canonical tags on any indexable page
Zero JSON-LD structured data across all tested pages
SEO landing pages are critically thin (120–150 words vs ~800 target)
Staging Hostinger subdomain indexed instead of production clearmeta.app
quick_wins: Remove /verify from sitemap until it returns 200 for anonymous users
Add per-page canonical tags via Next.js metadata.alternates.canonical
Give /app unique title and meta description
Defer Clerk JS on marketing pages to improve LCP

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Strong robots.txt with AI bot rules

findings.title: /verify in sitemap returns 404
findings.description: Clerk auth.protect() blocks unauthenticated crawlers; sitemap and nav link to broken URL.
findings.recommendation: Remove from sitemap or publish a public marketing page at /verify before auth gate.

findings.title: Missing canonical tags
findings.description: No rel=canonical on any tested page despite metadataBase in layout.
findings.recommendation: Add alternates.canonical per page in Next.js metadata exports.

findings.title: Missing HSTS header
findings.recommendation: Add HSTS via Traefik or Next.js headers.

findings.title: Thin SEO landing pages
findings.description: /remove-* pages are 120–148 words with shared template structure.
findings.recommendation: Expand each page to 600–900 words with intent-specific H2 sections.

findings.title: Duplicate title/meta on / and /app
findings.description: Both pages share identical title and description.
findings.recommendation: Add unique metadata export to src/app/app/page.tsx.

findings.title: No About page or operator identity
findings.description: Footer shows copyright only; weak E-E-A-T trust signals.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single H1 on all public pages
Meta descriptions on most indexable pages

findings.title: Title template double brand suffix
findings.description: Pages show 'ClearMeta | ClearMeta' due to layout template plus page titles.
findings.recommendation: Use absolute titles or remove — ClearMeta from page-level titles.

findings.title: Auth pages indexable without noindex
findings.recommendation: Add robots: { index: false } to auth page metadata.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Open Graph and Twitter Card basics present

findings.title: Zero JSON-LD
findings.description: No Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, or FAQPage schema detected.
findings.recommendation: Add @graph in layout.tsx and FAQPage on /faq.

findings.title: LCP 6.1s (Poor)
findings.description: Clerk auth handshake redirect chain and ~398KB Clerk JS on marketing pages.
findings.recommendation: Load Clerk only on auth/checkout routes; fix production Clerk cookie config.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Excellent robots.txt for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot

findings.title: Domain mismatch in llms.txt
findings.description: llms.txt references clearmeta.app while site runs on hstgr.cloud staging.
findings.recommendation: Align llms.txt URLs with live production domain before launch.

findings.title: FAQ answers too short for AI citation
findings.description: Answers are 16–33 words; optimal passage length is 134–167 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand FAQ answers with self-contained definitional blocks.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No missing alt text on img elements

findings.title: Missing og:image
findings.recommendation: Add 1200x630 branded og:image with alt text.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Remove /verify from sitemap or fix crawler access

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Unique /app metadata and noindex auth pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add About page and operator identity
Add homepage body links to SEO landing pages
Build brand signals (demos, citations, community presence)

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Submit sitemap in Google Search Console on production domain
Run drift baseline after production launch
